_comment: Production for c4studios.com.au is Cloudflare Pages, which reads public/_headers
and ignores this file entirely. This project exists on Vercel as the preview
environment only, so everything here applies to c4-main.vercel.app and nothing
else. On 3 Sep 2026 that host was found serving a complete, publicly indexable
copy of the live site with 'index, follow' in the markup - a second version of
every page competing with the real domain. The markup is shared between hosts,
so the fix has to be a header, and headers are the one thing each host sets
